vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: seo-content-pro
Version: 1.0.0

The skill bundle 'seo-content-pro' consists of metadata and markdown instructions designed to guide an AI agent in performing SEO content creation tasks, such as keyword research via SearXNG and multi-language drafting. There is no executable code provided, and the instructions in SKILL.md are strictly aligned with the stated purpose of SEO optimization without any evidence of prompt injection, data exfiltration, or malicious intent. The inclusion of a PayPal email (492227637@qq.com) in the documentation appears to be for marketing or service monetization rather than a technical threat.

llm.summary: Instruction-only SEO content skill whose stated features align with its runtime instructions; nothing requests unrelated secrets or high privileges, but there are small unexplained choices to verify before trusting it fully.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (SEO content, research, multi-language, scoring) match the SKILL.md instructions. Required binary 'curl' is reasonable for web research via SearXNG. The declared dependency on 'python3' is plausible (local scoring or text processing) but is not demonstrated in the instructions — minor mismatch worth verifying.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md stays within SEO content creation: researching top results (via SearXNG), generating outlines/drafts, scoring, and refreshing content. It asks users to paste content for refresh and to provide topics; it does not instruct reading unrelated system files or requesting credentials. The skill will perform network requests to fetch/search pages — expected for its purpose.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files — instruction-only, so nothing is written to disk during install. This is low-risk from an installation perspective.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No required secret env vars or credentials. Optional env vars (CONTENT_TONE, DEFAULT_LENGTH, CONTENT_LANGUAGE, SEARXNG_URL) are proportional to an SEO writer. SEARXNG_URL defaults to localhost, so users should ensure the configured search instance is trusted before directing searches to it.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No 'always: true' or other elevated persistence requested. The skill is user-invocable and may be used autonomously by the agent (platform default), which is expected for this kind of capability.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent for SEO content creation and does not ask for secrets or system-level access. Before installing or using it: 1) Verify the skill source (no homepage or publisher info is provided). 2) Confirm why 'python3' is required if you want to minimize runtime binaries — ask the author or run it in a sandbox. 3) Make sure SEARXNG_URL points to a trusted search instance (do not point it to a public/unknown server if you will paste confidential text). 4) Do not paste sensitive or proprietary documents into the skill when testing. 5) If you plan to connect it to publishing automations (social-media-automator, rss-to-social), review those skills' credential requirements separately — this skill does not itself request publishing credentials. If you need higher assurance, request the skill's source or a more detailed runtime spec before deploying widely.
